summary: Iteration 46 testing complete. All three new features verified working: 1) Milestone Excel Export - exports successfully with milestones sheets per wave, 2) Gantt Drag-Drop - milestone diamonds have cursor-grab class for dragging, 3) Phase Activities & Deliverables - modal opens with wave/phase selectors, add activity/deliverable buttons, template management tab. issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - minor recharts sizing issue

GanttCard.js (lines 85-190): Drag-drop handlers well implemented - handleMilestoneDragStart/Move/End with proper phase bounds clamping, payment milestones snap to start/mid/end, marker milestones get percentage position
PhaseActivitiesModal.js: Clean implementation with mode toggle (Project Activities vs Manage Templates), proper API integration for CRUD operations, adopt-template functionality
activities.py router: Proper REST API design with upsert pattern for templates and project activities, adopt-template correctly copies activities with new IDs

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified three new features: 1) Milestone Excel Export - click Export button in toolbar, shows 'Exported to Excel successfully' toast, Excel file includes milestones sheets per wave with payment/marker sections. 2) Gantt Drag-Drop - milestone diamonds on Gantt chart have cursor-grab class, can be dragged horizontally within phase bounds.
